reason: A design-system skill and browser-based audit tool that measures rendered web pages against configurable visual, layout, and accessibility-oriented rules.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供设计系统约束，并在浏览器中审计网页渲染结果的排版、对比度、间距、配色和交互尺寸。
summaries.en: Provides design-system guidance and audits rendered web pages in a browser for typography, contrast, spacing, color, and interactive target dimensions.

capabilities: Renders URLs or local HTML in a browser
Measures rendered typography, contrast, spacing, palette, tap targets, line length, fonts, gradients, and emoji icons
Provides design-system guidance for agent-generated interfaces
